summary.en: Open-source LLMs from Meta, widely adopted with strong community support.
summary.zh: Meta 的开源大语言模型，广泛采用，社区支持强大。

title.en: Meta Llama API Key - Official Llama Models Access | Get Model Key
title.zh: Meta Llama API Key - Llama 模型官方入口 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get official Meta Llama API key for Llama models. Access open-source Llama 3 series and Code Llama.
description.zh: 获取 Meta Llama 模型的官方 API Key。访问开源的 Llama 3 系列和 Code Llama。

en: Meta Llama is a widely used open-weight LLM family. Many teams self-host weights; Meta also documents API access paths on llama.com.
Official API access may involve an access or request flow rather than an instant consumer key—follow Meta’s current llama.com/api process.
Get Model Key only links https://www.llama.com/api. We do not distribute Llama weights licenses or sell Meta API keys.
zh: Meta Llama 是广泛使用的开源权重大模型系列。许多团队自托管权重；Meta 也在 llama.com 提供 API 接入说明。
官方 API 可能走申请/开通流程，而非即时消费级发 Key——请以 llama.com/api 当前流程为准。
Get Model Key 仅链接 https://www.llama.com/api。本站不发放权重许可，也不出售 Meta API Key。

en: Visit https://www.llama.com/api and review Meta’s current access instructions.
Complete any account, agreement, or access-request steps required on the official site.
If an API key or credential is issued, store it server-side and never commit it to git.
Use https://llama.meta.com/docs for model cards, usage terms, and integration details.
zh: 访问 https://www.llama.com/api ，阅读 Meta 当前的接入说明。
按官网要求完成账号、协议或访问申请等步骤。
若获发 API Key/凭证，仅存服务端，切勿提交到代码仓库。
查阅 https://llama.meta.com/docs 了解模型说明、使用条款与集成细节。

question.en: Do I need Meta’s API to use Llama?
question.zh: 使用 Llama 必须走 Meta API 吗？

answer.en: No. You can often self-host open weights under Meta’s license, or call Llama via third-party hosts. Official API is one option.
answer.zh: 不必。可在许可范围内自托管开源权重，或通过第三方托管调用。官方 API 只是选项之一。

question.zh: Key 一定是即时发放吗？

answer.en: Not necessarily. Meta’s API page may require access requests or eligibility checks—follow the live official flow.
answer.zh: 不一定。官方 API 页可能需要申请或资格审核，请以当时官网流程为准。

question.en: Does this site sell Meta Llama keys?
question.zh: 本站出售 Meta Llama Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link Meta’s official API page. All access decisions happen on Meta’s side.
answer.zh: 不出售。本站只链接 Meta 官方 API 页，开通与否由 Meta 侧决定。
